title_internal: She was stuck for 7 years. Then 42 days.

rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Letter unfurls in opening frames; folds back into identical shape in closing frames. Visual loop is seamless
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: Faint date stamp on the letter reads 'Dec 14, 2018' (the day Mei started). Only readable when paused on watch #2. Reveals that 7 years was Dec 2018 to current date
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens with 'stuck for seven years' (sympathy/sadness). Closes with 'difference was what she did with the time' (agency/hope). Same word 'time' carries opposite emotional weight
rewatch_engineering.info_density: Lists 4 failed methods + 3 drills + 2 numbers (22 min, 42 days) + 1 result (C1 exam) in 40 seconds. Viewers loop to extract the routine
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Calendar page flips on the beat, accelerating from 1Hz to 2Hz to mirror Mei's progress

beats.visual: Cream paper unfurls into a handwritten letter on dark background. Date stamp 'Dec 14, 2018' faintly visible bottom-right (8% opacity, 14px - hidden detail)
beats.caption: Mei was stuck for 7 YEARS
beats.voice_line: Mei was stuck for seven years.

beats.visual: Calendar pages flipping at 1Hz, sun rising and setting through window in background
beats.caption: Every day. | Every single day.
beats.voice_line: She studied English every day. Every single day.

beats.visual: Quick cut montage on the beat: stack of books -> phone with app -> Zoom tutor screen -> red-X test paper
beats.caption: Books. | Apps. | Tutors. | Tests.
beats.voice_line: Books. Apps. Tutors. Tests. Nothing worked.

beats.visual: All sound stops. Single black frame. White text appears: 'Then she stopped.'
beats.caption: Then she stopped.
beats.audio: SUDDEN SILENCE except sustained piano note

beats.visual: Letter fades back in. Calendar flips faster (1.5Hz). Three icons fade in below text
beats.caption: She STOPPED studying. | Started 3 DRILLS.
beats.voice_line: She stopped studying. And started doing three drills.

beats.visual: Three icons enlarge in sequence: speaking silhouette -> notebook with highlighted phrases -> waveform with 1s delay
beats.caption: 1. MONOLOGUE | 2. CHUNK MINING | 3. SHADOWING
beats.voice_line: Two-minute monologue. Chunk mining. One-second shadowing.

beats.visual: Stopwatch shows 22:00. Calendar pages blur-flip rapidly. Text overlay: '22 MIN' / '42 DAYS'
beats.caption: 22 MIN/DAY | 42 DAYS TOTAL
beats.voice_line: Twenty-two minutes a day. Forty-two days total.

beats.visual: Hands holding a certificate stamped 'C1 - PASSED'. Warm light
beats.caption: She passed C1.
beats.voice_line: She just passed her C1 speaking exam.

beats.visual: Side-by-side: '7 YEARS' (grey, struck through) vs '42 DAYS' (gold, glowing)
beats.caption: 7 YEARS  vs  42 DAYS
beats.voice_line: Seven years. Forty-two days. The difference wasn't time.

beats.visual: Letter visible again, fully unfurled. Pen writing the words 'what you do with it'
beats.caption: The difference was | what she did | WITH the time.
beats.voice_line: The difference was what she did with the time.

beats.visual: Letter folds back into its closed shape (matches the opening visual for loop trick). Text fades over: 'Then she wasn't.'
beats.caption: Stuck for 7 years. | Then she wasn't.
beats.audio: paper folding sound + piano final note
beats.voice_line: Mei was stuck for seven years. Then she wasn't.
